title: Yggdrasil porridge

infobox.Crafting Materials: Sap x4, Barley x3, Royal jelly x2

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Yggdrasil porridge is a Mistlands-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Yggdrasil porridge is produced at a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 4 Sap
• 3 Barley
• 2 Royal jelly

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Yggdrasil porridge provides the second highest eitr gain in the Mistlands at 80, second to Seeker aspic at 85.
• Two pieces of Royal jelly yields two Seeker aspics (a 2:2 ratio of jelly to aspic), whereas two pieces of Royal jelly yield only one Yggdrasil porridge (a 2:1 ratio of jelly to porridge).
